title: Three Autumns and One Short Spoon
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：jam　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 jam 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the grandmother ① spread the jam that no grandchild in the pantry would have recorded, and he said the spreading was the whole of the Sunday. The ② jam, meaning the fruit itself and not the spoon, ran three Sundays and stayed unrecorded in the book; jam, he said, is the only thing in a pantry that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of jam in that pantry had the same short spoon beside it, and the ④ jam at the far window, meaning the jar they kept for the children to open and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Jam, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grandmother said the recording is the part that fills three Sundays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the jam was the whole of the matter, meaning the sweetness and not the fruit. The ⑥ jam, meaning the sweetness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; jam, he said, is either something you spread or the only word that means both fruit and a sweetness. He said the sweetness is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ jam had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short spoon. The ⑧ jam of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in September, was one pantry and three Sundays of recording; jam, he said, is either the jar at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ jam I remember is the jam recorded in the note, which closed in 1970 and is still recorded as the quietest in the pantry. ⑩ Jam, my mother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all jam, she said, is a sweetness that has agreed to look like fruit. She said the sweetness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 果酱（指储藏室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 果酱（指那罐果泥本身，与木勺相对）
C. 固定搭配：spread the jam 涂抹这罐果酱
D. n. 果酱（指留给孩子们开的那一罐那一罐）
E. n. 熬制之事（抽象总称，指一处储藏室的果酱之事）
F. n. 果酱（指便条里写到、被记下的的那一罐）
G. n. 甜味、甜头（指一件事里人人都抹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 甜头（抽象总称，指人人都抹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: spread the jam that no grandchild in the pantry would have recorded
The jam, meaning the fruit itself and not the spoon
Every kind of jam in that pantry
the jam at the far window
the jam was the whole of the matter

The jam of the whole thing

answers.why: spread the jam 意为“涂抹这罐果酱”，1963 年那位祖母把储藏室里没有一位孙辈肯记录的一罐果酱做了一遍。
jam 意为“果酱”，指那罐果泥本身而不是木勺，它经过了三个星期天而在簿子上没有被记录。
jam 意为“果酱”，指储藏室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一把小小的木勺。
jam 意为“果酱”，指最远那扇窗台留给孩子们开的那一罐那一罐，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
jam 意为“甜味、甜头”，指一件事里人人都抹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份甜头就是那件事的全部。
jam 意为“甜头”，指人人都抹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那罐果泥，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
jam 意为“果酱”，指便条里写到、被记下的的那一罐，到 1968 年这一罐成了便条里的一行。
jam 意为“熬制之事”，祖母九月写道，整件事的果酱之事是一处储藏室和三个星期天的记录。
jam 意为“果酱”，我记得的是便条里记录过的那一罐，1970 年吃完了，至今仍被说成储藏室里最安静的一罐。
jam 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，果酱是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的果泥。

那罐果酱，指的是那罐果泥本身而不是木勺，经过了三个星期天而在簿子上没有被记录。（jam）
那处储藏室里每一种果酱旁边都有同一把小小的木勺。（jam）
最远那扇窗台那罐果酱，指的是他们留给孩子们开的那一罐那一罐，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（jam）
叔叔说这份甜头就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那罐果泥。（jam）
